invariants.rationale: The method requires a HoodieEngineContext to perform the insert, so context should not be null.
instantTime represents a commit instant and is essential for correct operation, so it should not be null.
The method expects a list of records to insert; a null value would prevent insertion.
It may be nonsensical to perform an insert with an empty record list; while not strictly forbidden, many insert patterns require at least one record.
instantTime should not be an empty string, as it identifies the instant for the insert operation.
